Major Error Fixed!

Also fixed minor glitches: Mulching only needs 3 (not 4) now, Gramps can't block day-pass if talk first.

notes.title: Major Update: Version 1.23
notes.notes: [p]I combined 2 updates into one here. In ver.1.22, Lupin Village is a new late-game location. It's found by beating the Minotaurs at the far right of the main village. Lupin village is a separate questline for Harlot.. although she can return to the home village by ship and bring her team over, I didn't have time to add any real content for the other team members. Harlot will fight 3 types of dogs in Lupin and when she's strong enough, she can enter the Werewolf Tower and fight 3 bosses who each have a unique item. Here's an image of Lupin:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/b6838845ddede2fe60bdfd7fc05dab4ff1904ad6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the Werewolf Tower fights, Harlot will need to beat stray dogs and build up her resistance to the Boss attacks, but it's worth it to find the treasures they protect:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/3f21071865a34a8cdb16a21f2cc46fc447187a59.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Since Lupin village is late-game, I also spent a month adding in earlier content in ver.1.23: Pregnancy, Conditions, and Cooking. Pregnancy art works in the normal game events, and Harlot's belly has 3 sizes. She will get a baby at the end, which follows her around, and you can build a nursery in the basement too. Baby items are sold by the Merchant. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/a08ad8aa566bb67a25104f1ee4df045379d73e6b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/dc17c6fdd08387e142710c9728c5d5a9366b65a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Conditions are semi-permanent effects Harlot gets from different sex actions. There are 6 total, and they are visible in the Skills screen. Cooking can be done on any stove and there are 3 levels. Basic cooking only requires one ingredient and can be done anytime, Meals require hidden recipes that are hard to find, and Concoctions require rare items, but will tell you if you can craft them.[/p][p]Note: You can disable Pregnancy, Baby, and Conditions in the Settings board behind the Hovel if you don't like them. Also, your saveFiles are NOT deleted and should be compatible with this update. The previous post explains how to find them and transfer them to the new updated game.[/p][p]It's been about 4 months work on this update. I've tested it extensively but there are always bugs. Let me know if you find any serious ones![/p]

notes.title: Cecilia Re-designed
notes.notes:
Cecilia Event was re-designed. Abby can now slowly corrupt- err... train her into having sex. As her trust in Abby increases, she'll unlock Handjobs, Blowjobs, Anal and Vaginal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/3e4d9675f3ac2b9bb952a887c8b4fe92c0c81e02.jpg[/img]

Cecilia will also join your team and start putting on shows in the village for coins. You can also choose to have her sex the village men for more coins. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/92b7e181b92b513a4b70788a7d655dd349a79641.jpg[/img]

Cecilia can also build a room in the brothel basement and even plant vegetables nearby. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023020/0987afda2e99e3ba6e9428a67f2b5e7a829d9d8b.jpg[/img]

Took about 2 month of work to complete and I've tested it extensively... but, I'm sure there are still bugs... so, please let me know in the comments below if you find any.

notes.title: Important information about Save Files!
notes.notes:
This is a note from SlingBang about transferring save files.

When the RPG Maker games update, the Save files do NOT transfer, but, they are NOT deleted! To transfer your saves please follow these steps:

Right-Click Harlot Path name in left-panel of Steam window (game library)
Choose Properties, Choose Installed Files, Click Browse button.
Select PREVIOUS version. (eg: HarlotsPath120c)
Open folder. Open WWW folder, Copy the save folder (CTRL+C)
go back to main folder and choose new version (eg: HarlotsPath120d)
Open folder. Open WWW folder, Paste the save folder (CTRL+V)

That's it. Your save files are transferred.
